title: When skills meet scale: an agent assembly line for dbt
description:
When skills meet scale: an agent assembly line for dbt at Riot Games, built on dbt v2 for the Echoes on the Rift event. From dbt Summit 2026.

Explore dbt Summit 2026 and watch more sessions: https://www.getdbt.com/dbt-summit

Jess Zhang, senior data engineer at Riot Games, shows how her team used a layered agent architecture and dbt v2 to rebuild a cross-title data pipeline. An agentic assembly line has five stations that discover columns, profile data, author a silver model, build a gold model, and validate the result. Layered context combines a system prompt for persona, a shared playbook for conventions, and a one-sentence task prompt from an analyst. The shift is in the cost curve: in the old model, the 200th model cost as much engineering time as the first.

In this session you'll learn:
• How a five-station agent assembly line builds dbt models
• How layered context keeps agents consistent
• How agentic development changes the cost of each new model

Speaker: Jess Zhang, senior data engineer, Riot Games

Learn more about dbt and AI: https://www.getdbt.com/product/ai
